line.all_set.done: Last time, it finished its task.
line.all_set.new: It has not done its task yet.
line.all_set.nothing: Last time, it found nothing to do.
line.all_set.stopped_early: Last time, it stopped before the task was done, and it needs nothing from you now.
line.all_set.tried_today: It has started as often as it may today, so it waits until tomorrow.
line.asks.draft_and_confirm: It asks you before it pays, orders, sends, signs, submits, or removes anything.
line.asks.observe: It only looks and never acts for you.
line.asks.unattended: It asks before anything you did not allow, and always before paying, ordering or signing.
line.files: It can open the files that you choose.
line.needs_you.check: It needs you to say whether its last task went through.
line.needs_you.confirm: It needs your answer before it can go on.
line.needs_you.link_account: It needs you to link your mail or calendar account.
line.needs_you.ready: It is ready to start when you are.
line.needs_you.setup: It needs a few answers from you before it can start.
line.needs_you.show: It needs you to show it how to do the task once.
line.needs_you.sign_in: It needs you to sign in to a site.
line.needs_you.stuck: It is stuck and needs your help with one step.
line.not_yet.category: Halvo cannot do this kind of task yet.
line.off.person: You switched it off, so it does not start.
line.problem.budget: Last time, it asked you too many questions, so Halvo stopped it.
line.problem.class_mismatch: Last time, Halvo stopped it before it did something that it is not allowed to do.
line.problem.failed: Last time, it could not finish its task.
line.problem.failures: It failed several times in a row, so Halvo switched it off.
line.problem.kind: Last time, it asked for something that Halvo does not allow, so Halvo stopped it.
line.problem.limit: Last time, it took too long, so Halvo stopped it.
line.problem.refused: Last time, Halvo stopped one of its steps, so the task was not done.
line.run.budget: It asked you too many questions, so Halvo stopped it.
line.run.class_mismatch: It stopped before it did something that it is not allowed to do.
line.run.declined: You said no, so it stopped.
line.run.deleted: It stopped because the agent was deleted.
line.run.effect_unknown: It could not tell whether its last step went through.
line.run.failed: It could not finish the task.
line.run.handed_back: It stopped at a step that it could not get past, and it tries again next time.
line.run.kind: It asked for something that Halvo does not allow, so Halvo stopped it.
line.run.lapsed: It stopped because you did not answer in time.
line.run.limit: It took too long, so Halvo stopped it.
line.run.refused: Halvo stopped one of its steps, so the task was not done.
line.time: It stops if its task takes more than {minutes} minutes.
line.waiting_turn.queued: Only one agent works at a time, so it starts when its turn comes.
line.waiting_turn.store: It waits while Halvo wraps up the task it did before, and you need to do nothing.
line.working.working: It is doing its task now.
note.no_service: Halvo cannot show your agents right now.
note.roster_full: You have as many agents as Halvo can hold, so it cannot add one for a new task.
param_typed.full: Your answer is full, so the last thing you added was left out. Shorten it to add more.
param_typed.too_long: Something you added was too long to fit, so none of it was added. Read your answer before sending.
say.item.gone: “{name}” no longer has a question for you.
say.item.new: “{name}” has a new question for you.
